purpose: Give every standing investment monitor the same auditable attention and public-information checks while selecting operational evidence from the way the business actually earns money.

google_search_attention.contract: Use identity-preserving queries. Compare complete windows inside one request, show dated values, leave missing dates blank, and never convert attention into sales.

public_information_parity.contract: Check public issuer, regulator, call, product, business-news and publicly visible sell-side evidence separately. A missing paywalled note is never represented as checked or as silence.

consumer_product.economic_mechanism: A consumer sees the product, finds it in stock, buys or tries it, repeats, and the behavior reaches retailer sell-through and issuer economics.

industrial_and_data_center.economic_mechanism: A buyer commits money or capacity, a project clears permits and power constraints, equipment ships or backlog converts, and the economics reach the listed supplier.

integrity_rules: Missing and failed observations remain missing; no interpolation or zero-filling.
Every displayed count must reconcile to persisted evidence links or show a mismatch.
Comments and replies never inflate original-post counts.
Attention does not become revenue without a separately cited economic bridge.
A public-information check is downstream parity evidence, never the primary discovery edge.
Page loads read persisted artifacts and make zero upstream calls.
No monitor can place, close or resize a trade.
